title: QISK: Quantum-Inspired Streaming Kernels for Robust Classification under Concept Drift

contributions.purpose: 提升概念漂移下流式分类的特征表示
contributions.mechanism: 多参数化量子启发核集成(Pauli-X/Y/Z 旋转)+ 基于核-目标对齐(KTA)的自适应加权,全经典计算模拟
contributions.evaluation: 消融显示可训练量子核较固定核 +7.6%,较可训练经典核额外 +2.8%(平衡准确率)
contributions.domain: 流式分类 / 分布鲁棒优化
contributions.source_quote: An ensemble of quantum-inspired kernels with different parameterizations (Pauli-X, Pauli-Y, Pauli-Z rotations) and adaptive weighting based on kernel-target alignment.

contributions.purpose: 更全面地检测概念漂移
contributions.mechanism: 集成 KS 检验 + Wasserstein 距离 + 错误率监控
contributions.evaluation: 作为组件纳入总体 +12-14% 提升,未单列独立数字
contributions.source_quote: Advanced drift detection ensemble combining statistical tests (Kolmogorov-Smirnov), distribution measures (Wasserstein distance), and error-rate monitoring.

contributions.mechanism: Enhanced DRO-Lite:多密度比估计器(logistic 判别器、KMM、残差)集成
contributions.evaluation: 去 DRO-Lite 平衡准确率 0.929→0.895(SEA),贡献 +3.4%
contributions.source_quote: Enhanced DRO-Lite with multiple density ratio estimation methods ... and ensemble combination for robust importance weighting.

contributions.purpose: 实验验证最差情形性能提升
contributions.mechanism: 两合成漂移基准上与 SVM/固定量子核/自适应随机森林/Hoeffding 树对比
contributions.source_quote: QISK achieving 12-14% absolute improvements over state-of-the-art baselines.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Enhanced DRO-Lite with multiple density ratio estimation methods (logistic discriminators, Kernel Mean Matching, residual-based estimation).

notes: 数据可信度红旗:种子数自相矛盾——Baselines 段称 '5-seed aggregation',Statistical Analysis 段称 '10 independent random seeds'。消融用平衡准确率(SEA 全模型 0.929)与主表 Table 2 标准准确率(SEA 0.874)口径不一致,作者自注 '数值不可直接比较'。仅两个合成漂移生成器(SEA、Rotating Hyperplane),无真实数据,作者在 Limitations 承认评测范围受限。'量子启发' 实为全经典模拟。4 条编号贡献。
